body.name: ledger-projected positive execution domain
body.construction:
For a returned formula, let \(\mathcal D_H^{\mathrm{den}}=(d_1,\ldots,d_R)\) be the ordered deduplicated projection of the step-indexed ledger onto every actual divisor used by the accepting run, including intermediate divisors later cancelled from the reduced formula.  After cancellation and sign normalization, each \(d_j\) retains its exact cross-multiplied identity, earlier-entry dependencies, nonempty reachable-cell set, and verified factorization into a positive rational constant, earlier positive entries, and positive kernel-cell sums.  Define
\[
 \mathfrak D_H=
 \{q\in\Delta(\mathcal C_H^{\mathrm{adm}}):q(c)>0
 \text{ for every branch-required cell and }d_j(q)>0
 \text{ for }j=1,\ldots,R\}.
\]
The emitted rational circuit \(F_H\) is evaluated only on \(\mathfrak D_H\).
